objective: Evaluate recommendation quality observations using the certified Human Review instrument (not to draw tuning conclusions).

acceptanceCriteria.name: Rubric version preserved for every judgment
Report generation is deterministic from identical inputs
Every review links to exact frozen profile and recommendation snapshot

observations.observation: Maturity-boundary uncertainty appears repeatedly in teen-focused reviewed slates.
Series entry-point concerns recur across preteen/adult reviewed profiles.
Reviewer disagreement is preserved for selected mystery profiles and remains visible in raw records.
Average reviewed item scores vary by age band in this bounded sample and should be treated as descriptive only.

prioritizedHypotheses.hypothesis: Richer independent age-fit evidence could reduce maturity-boundary uncertainty in teen mystery/sci-fi slates.
prioritizedHypotheses.controlledIntervention: Add diagnostics-only evidence lineage for teen-fit authority, then run controlled eligibility-only A/B on frozen fixtures before policy changes.

prioritizedHypotheses.hypothesis: Entry-point uncertainty may be reduced by explicit sequence/volume provenance in candidate diagnostics.
prioritizedHypotheses.controlledIntervention: Introduce source-neutral sequence diagnostics; compare pre/post Human Review deltas without ranking changes first.

prioritizedHypotheses.hypothesis: Novelty concerns may indicate insufficient diversification cues at selection time for some profiles.
prioritizedHypotheses.controlledIntervention: Design bounded diversity-cue experiment with deterministic replay and post-change Human Review rerun.

prioritizedHypotheses.hypothesis: Tone-intensity mismatch may be reduced by stronger tone-evidence normalization before scoring.
prioritizedHypotheses.controlledIntervention: Run normalization-only shadow experiment and compare deterministic outputs before any production change.

unsupportedConclusions: Any observed weakness must be fixed before a controlled intervention is designed
notes: This study establishes a reproducible quality observation baseline.
Review records in this run are synthetic study fixtures intended to exercise the certified pipeline end-to-end.
Follow-up quality studies should replace fixture reviewers with real reviewer submissions while preserving artifact invariants.
